promise: Provide Ukraine an $8.1 billion, 48-month Extended Fund Facility arrangement approved in February 2026
description: The IMF Executive Board approved a new 48-month Extended Fund Facility arrangement for Ukraine of about $8.1 billion on February 26, 2026. The first review was completed on July 20, 2026, with about $690 million disbursed, bringing total disbursements to about $2.2 billion.
evidence: First review completed July 20, 2026 with about $690 million disbursed
